compliance_decision:
**Compliance Answer:** Aggregated transactions should be listed individually if they exceed the prescribed threshold, even when made in smaller amounts over a period of time by the same client or for the same business relationship.

**Relevant Regulatory Basis:** Source 1 - Guidance Note on CTRs (2019.03-Guidance-Draft-Guidance-Note-05C) Chunk 396, Section 27 and Example provided in the same section

**Explanation:** The regulatory guidance specifies that a series of smaller transactions should be aggregated if they occur within a certain period, are repetitions of the same type (e.g., cash payments or deposits), involve the same client, or relate to the same business relationship and exceed the threshold amount set by regulations. These must then be listed individually on an aggregated transaction report (CTRA).

**Human Review Required:** Yes
